RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 45

An all-male panel may breach institutional equity policies and increases the risk of unconscious in-group bias, particularly given your stronger traditional academic record. However, legitimate non-discriminatory factors often drive academic hiring, such as specific subfield alignment, interview performance, or curricular demand for industry experience.

Directly alleging sex discrimination at this stage is premature and could damage professional relationships. Instead, send a polite follow-up regarding your requested feedback. If the university remains unresponsive or the rationale appears arbitrary, consult your faculty union or institutional equity office. They can examine whether search procedures and panel diversity guidelines were breached without requiring you to make an unsubstantiated personal accusation.
